title: Count each specimen once per rejection reason
prompt:
Correct duplicate counting in the rejection-rate portion of lib/ohworks-quality-indicators.ts. Lines 377-381 already construct receivedIds, but lines 390-396 count raw rejection events and divide by the raw received-event length. Verified reproduction with one received specimen and two identical rejection events produces numerator 2, denominator 1, and ratePercent 200. Repeating a received event can conversely dilute the rate. These rates feed the displayed quality indicators through lib/ohworks-demo-quality-indicators-view.ts:79-84 and app/pilot/ohworks/page.tsx:28.

Use unique received specimen identifiers for the rejection denominator and unique specimen identifiers per reason for each rejection numerator. A specimen rejected for two distinct declared reasons should count once in each reason, while duplicate copies of the same rejection must not increase either count. Preserve validation of unknown specimens and reasons, zero-denominator null behavior, target values, and every other quality indicator. Keep this one change inside the existing module.

Add tests/ohworks/rejection-rate-unique-specimens.test.ts for duplicate receipts, duplicate same-reason rejections, two reasons on one specimen, an empty period, and permutation invariance. Assert exact numerator, denominator, and rate, including 100 rather than 200 for the reproduction. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks/rejection-rate-unique-specimens.test.ts tests/ohworks/quality-indicators.test.ts tests/ohworks/demo-quality-indicators-view.test.ts. Use fabricated records; work on the assigned branch you are on. Edit only the named production file and new test. No credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, workflows, package.json, auth changes, commits, or pushes.
